category_title: Boys who project personal experiences of physical abuse onto bullying behavior
student_description: This student exhibits bullying behavior that is deeply rooted in his own trauma from physical abuse at home. He projects his victimization onto others, viewing aggression as a symptom of sadness rather than malice. He uniquely requires highly structured, non-physical role-play to safely project his feelings, alongside explicit discussions of displacement and strict guarantees of confidentiality.

criteria.rationale: Explicitly discussing how trauma at home can be redirected as aggression helps this student accurately interpret his own and others' behaviors.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term plan includes explicitly introducing and discussing the psychological concept of 'displacement' to help the student connect his home experiences to bullying behavior.

criteria.rationale: This student's deep vulnerability regarding his father's abuse requires an exceptionally safe environment where he feels in control of his participation and data.
criteria.check: The tutor's long-term plan includes individual meetings that explicitly guarantee confidentiality and provide the student with a clear, ongoing option to opt out of the activities.
